ai_preview.text:
**Deportivo de la Coruña host Alhama in a clash where one team's fighting for mid-table respectability and the other is basically already relegated.** 🔴

Depor are limping along at 2W-3L over five, while Alhama have bottled five straight — including a 5-1 hammering at home to Real Sociedad. The visitors won their last H2H, but that's ancient history in a season this bleak for them.

Key storylines:

- **Depor's attack** needs to click: E. Pizarro, B. Latorre, and A. Marín have underperformed relative to their placement
- **Alhama's defensive shape** (5-3-2) is desperate damage control against a superior opponent
- **Depor's midfield control** via L. M. González and P. Gutiérrez should dominate possession and tempo

Expected lineups:

- **Real Club Deportivo de la Coruña**: I. Pereira, R. G. Yagüe, V. Martínez, M. Barth, S. Ortíz, L. M. González, P. Gutiérrez, O. Rodríguez, B. Latorre, E. Pizarro, A. Marín
- **Alhama Club de Fútbol**: S. Belotto, C. Castiñeyras, J. Caravaca, N. Martinez, A. Santamaría, A. Zumárraga, A. Velázquez, Y. R. Ramos, Estefa, R. P. Saez, M. Gestera

Prediction:

**Depor 2-0 Alhama** — the hosts should roll through a team in free fall. 📍

**Excelsior hosting Utrecht in a dead-rubber feelsgood match** — both sides are battling mid-table inconsistency, and this Eredivisie clash could go either way. 🎯

Excelsior are stuck in neutral with just two draws across five, while **FC Utrecht** have actually found some rhythm with three wins recently. The home side's got injury headaches though, missing four players including Akujobi and Jonathans on ACL. Utrecht aren't exactly healthy either — Haller, Demircan, and Brouwer out — so squad depth could be the deciding factor.

Key storylines:

- **Excelsior** need a spark; their attacking play has been toothless, and they'll lean on d. Regt up front to do the heavy lifting
- **FC Utrecht's** momentum is real — Alarcón and Karlsson have been cutting it up in recent weeks, and they'll want to keep that rolling
- Head-to-head suggests parity; Utrecht edge it 3–4 across the last seven, but draws are the theme here

Expected lineups:

- **Excelsior**: S. van Gassel, A. Zagre, C. Widell, R. Meissen, I. Bronkhorst, L. Schouten, I. Yegoian, L. Hartjes, N. Naujoks, D. S. Fernandes, G. d. Regt
- **FC Utrecht**: V. Barkas, S. El Karouani, M. Didden, M. Van der Hoorn, N. B. V. Nielsen, G. Zechiël, A. Engwanda, Y. Cathline, D. de Wit, J. Karlsson, Á. Alarcón

Prediction:

**1–1 draw** — both sides scrappy and injury-hit, Utrecht's form not quite enough to break through at Woudestein. 🤝

**Wisła Płock hit a hot streak right when it matters most** — four wins in their last five have them looking sharp, while Radomiak's inconsistency makes this a tricky Sunday morning clash. 🔥

Płock are rolling at home with wins over Gdańsk and Nieciecza fresh in the tank. Radomiak grabbed a win vs Widzew but drew with Motor and lost to Zagłębie, so they're scattered. Their head-to-head last time ended level, so neither side has the recent edge.

Key storylines:

- **Wisła's form** is the real story — four wins in five is momentum you can't ignore at the Orlen Arena
- **Radomiak's defense** led by **J. Grzesik** and **A. Diéguez** will have their hands full with **D. Jurić** and **L. Sekulski** up top
- **Luquinhas** and **C. Donis** in midfield need to orchestrate any comeback chance for Radom

Expected lineups:

- **Wisła Płock**: R. Leszczyński, M. Kamiński, M. Haglind Sangre, M. Karamarko, N. Mijuskovic, Q. Lecoeuche, W. Nowak, Ž. Rogelj, K. Savvidis, D. Jurić, L. Sekulski
- **Radomiak Radom**: F. Majchrowicz, J. Wilson-Esbrand, J. Grzesik, A. Diéguez, S. Kingue, R. Wolski, Luquinhas, I. Camará, C. Donis, R. Baró, Maurides

Prediction:

**Wisła Płock 2-1 Radomiak Radom** — slight lean to the home side's form advantage.

**Fiorentina's red-hot form meets Sassuolo's inconsistency** in a clash where Florence should have the edge at home. The hosts are riding a **3W-2D streak** while Sassuolo's wobbled between wins and losses. 🔴

Viola have momentum and a packed injury list that somehow hasn't derailed them. Sassuolo, missing Berardi to suspension, will scrape together what they can on the road.

Key storylines:

- **Fiorentina's defense holds steady** despite absences from Parisi, Gosens, and Lamptey — Ranieri, Comuzzo, and Rugani anchor the backline
- **Kean and Guðmundsson** carry the creative burden in attack for the hosts
- **Sassuolo chasing consistency** with Pinamonti and Laurienté up front, but Boloca's injury weakens the midfield engine

Expected lineups:

- **Fiorentina:** D. De Gea, L. Ranieri, P. Comuzzo, D. Rugani, L. Balbo, Dodô, R. Mandragora, C. Ndour, A. Guðmundsson, M. Kean, J. Fazzini
- **Sassuolo:** A. Murić, U. Garcia, J. Idzes, S. Walukiewicz, T. Muharemović, I. Koné, K. Thorstvedt, N. Matić, A. Laurienté, A. Pinamonti, A. Fadera

Prediction:

**Fiorentina 2-1 Sassuolo.** Viola have the lean at home with form and firepower on their side. 📍

**Costa Adeje's hot streak meets a reeling Sevilla side that's just shipped five goals at home.** This is the kind of fixture where momentum speaks louder than pedigree. 🔥

Costa Adeje are on a proper roll — three wins in their last five with clean sheets piling up. Sevilla, meanwhile, are in freefall: only two wins in five and a catastrophic 1-5 drubbing to FC Badalona suggests something's badly broken defensively.

Key storylines:

- **Costa Adeje's defensive solidity** has been the foundation of their recent form, while **Sevilla's fragile backline** looks ripe for exploitation
- **E. Sullastres** and company will need to shore up immediately; this is a must-stabilize moment for the visitors
- H2H favors **Costa Adeje**, who won their last meeting

Expected lineups:

- **Costa Adeje Tenerife**: N. Cáceres, P. G. Collado, E. Vergés, F. Dembele, V. Quiles, A. Zaremba, N. R. Álvarez, Y. Moreno, P. Hernández, P. Gramaglia, Iratxe
- **Sevilla FC**: E. Sullastres, R. M. Aparicio, I. Álvarez, A. Marques, D. García, A. Redondo, R. Márquez, M. Cortés, A. Álvarez, L. Moral, F. Kanteh

Prediction:

**Costa Adeje 2-0 Sevilla.** The hosts have the edge in form and familiarity — Sevilla's defensive issues make this a lean toward the home side.

**Slavia Sofia and Botev Vratsa kick off round 1 with completely deadlocked history** — these sides have split their last seven meetings 3-3, so don't expect clarity. 🏟️

Slavia's form is mixed (1W-2D-2L), but they showed teeth with a 3-1 away win at Cherno More. Botev just edged past Lokomotiv 3-2 at home and are slightly sharper, though both teams have been inconsistent.

Key storylines:

- **Slavia Sofia** rely on their home fortress at Aleksandar Shalamanov, where they've got the recent momentum edge despite patchy form
- **Botev Vratsa** have won their last two games and carry confidence into Sofia, testing the hosts' defensive stability
- Midfield battle shapes the tie — **I. Minchev** and **E. Stoev** vs **I. Yurukov** and **K. Malinov** will dictate tempo

Expected lineups:

- **Slavia Sofia**: L. Ntumba, J. Semedo Varela, N. Savić, D. Malembana, D. Ferraresso, I. Minchev, E. Stoev, R. Raychev, I. Stefanov, K. Balov, Y. Guermouche
- **Botev Vratsa**: L. Vasilev, I. Goranov, M. Stoev, Đ. Jovičić, M. Stoychev, I. Yurukov, K. Malinov, D. Genov, J. Gallegos, K. Hadji, M. Ntelo

Prediction:

**Botev Vratsa 2-1 Slavia Sofia** — slight edge to the visitors' momentum, though this feels tight given their head-to-head equilibrium. 📍

**Coventry City's fortress hosting Wrexham in a clash between inconsistency and injury chaos.** Both sides are mid-table grinders fighting for relevance, but the home crowd and recent form give one a real edge. 🏟️

Coventry's drawn three of their last five but smashed Portsmouth 5-1 at home — that's the kind of volatility that could swing either way. Wrexham's wobbled lately, dropping points to Birmingham, though they did sneak past Oxford and Stoke. The Sky Blues have momentum and familiarity with the Arena; Wrexham's defensive injuries pile up at the worst time.

Key storylines:

- **Coventry's home fortress** vs Wrexham's patchy away record — the Arena tends to matter
- **Wrexham's injury headaches** with B. Sheaf and L. Cacace sidelined could expose their midfield
- **E. Simms and K. Moore** as the focal points in attack — who finds space first?

Expected lineups:

- **Coventry City**: C. Rushworth, J. Dasilva, M. v. Ewijk, L. Kitching, B. Thomas, M. Grimes, F. Onyeka, H. Wright, M. Ephron, E. Simms, B. Thomas-Asante
- **Wrexham**: Arthur Okonkwo, C. Doyle, D. Hyam, M. Cleworth, D. Scarr, G. Thomason, L. O'Brien, G. Dobson, S. Smith, N. Broadhead, K. Moore

Prediction:

**Coventry City 2–0 Wrexham.** The Sky Blues' home edge and Wrexham's defensive vulnerabilities favor the hosts. 🎯

**UTA's on a rampage and Farul's barely treading water** — this feels like one of those Sundays where the form gap just swallows a struggling side whole. 🔥

UTA just demolished Metaloglobus 5-1 at home and beat Botoșani 3-1; they're cooking. Farul, meanwhile, has dropped points in three of their last four games and can't buy a clean sheet, so the stage is set for another UTA masterclass.

Key storylines:

- **UTA's attack** vs a **Farul defence** that's conceded in every recent outing — this could get ugly fast
- **H. Abdallah and M. Coman** leading UTA's assault against leaky Constanța backline
- Home advantage at **Stadionul Francisc von Neumann** adds another layer to UTA's edge

Expected lineups:

- **UTA Arad**: A. Gorcea, D. Alomerovic, F. Poulolo, D. Pospelov, F. Iacob, S. Mino, B. v. Durmen, M. Tzionis, R. Alin, M. Coman, H. Abdallah

- **FC Farul Constanța**: R. Munteanu, G. Marins, I. Larie, L. Pellegrini, C. Ganea, V. Dican, I. Vina, E. Radaslavescu, A. Ișfan, D. Alibec, D. Maftei

Prediction:

**UTA 3-0 FC Farul**. The form and firepower just aren't close here — expect a comfortable home win.

**Gençlerbirliği are in free fall, and Kocaelispor want to make it count.** The hosts haven't won in five, while the visitors are grinding out draws against the big boys — this is a chance to pounce. 📉

Gençlerbirliği's attack has been toothless lately, leaking goals on the regular. Kocaelispor aren't prolific either, but their defensive solidity gives them an edge in a clash between two struggling sides.

Key storylines:

- **S. Koita** will need to carry Gençlerbirliği's offensive load with Z. Zuzek sidelined by suspension.
- **H. Smolčić** anchors a Kocaelispor backline that's kept clean sheets in recent weeks, holding firm without M. Haidara.
- Gençlerbirliği's winless streak vs. a visitor who's drawn three of their last five — **resilience meets desperation** 💪

Expected lineups:

- **Gençlerbirliği**: R. Velho, M. Hanousek, T. Kelven, D. Goutas, P. Pereira, F. Tongya, M. Mimaroğlu, T. Dele-Bashiru, O. Ülgün, A. M. Traoré, S. Koita

- **Kocaelispor**: G. Değirmenci, M. Cinan, H. Smolčić, A. Oğuz, A. Dijksteel, K. Linetty, H. Keita, J. Nonge, R. Rivas, D. Agyei, S. Dursun

Prediction:

**Kocaelispor 1–0 Gençlerbirliği**. The visitors' defensive shape should hold firm; Gençlerbirliği's misfiring attack can't break through.

**Brugge roll into Gent looking to keep their unbeaten streak alive**, while the Buffalos are stuck in neutral—one win, three draws in their last five. 🔴

Gent's been leaky defensively and struggling to find the net, but Brugge just hammered Mechelen 6-1 and are playing a totally different level right now. This is a clash between form and desperation.

Key storylines:

- **Club Brugge** are the in-form juggernaut with four wins in five, while **KAA Gent** are bleeding confidence with draws piling up
- **Idrissa Cissé and Wouter Kanga** will need to be sharp up front for Gent against a Brugge defense that's been stubborn when healthy
- Gent's injury list is brutal—four players out—while Brugge are also missing pieces but haven't let it slow their roll

Expected lineups:

- **KAA Gent**: Roef, Volckaert, Araújo, V. D. Heyden, Hashioka, Skóraś, D. Vlieger, Hong, Dean, Kanga, Cisse
- **Club Brugge KV**: Jackers, Ordóñez, Mechele, Seys, Siquet, Tzolis, Stanković, Tresoldi, Forbs, Vermant, Lemaréchal

Prediction:

**Club Brugge 2-0 KAA Gent** — Brugge have the edge in momentum and firepower; expect them to control this one without much drama. ⚪

**Basel host a resurgent Sion side that's been absolutely ruthless lately** — this is a proper test for the hosts, who've been inconsistent while their visitors arrive on a three-win streak. 🔥

Basel's form is patchy (2W-1D-2L in five) and missing Xherdan Shaqiri through injury won't help matters. **FC Sion**, meanwhile, are rolling hard with three straight wins and haven't lost a game in their last five — they hammered Grasshopper 4-0 and breezed past Lausanne 3-0.

Key storylines:

- **Sion's clinical finishing** has been the standout; they're scoring freely while Basel have been shaky defensively down the stretch

- **Basel need creativity** with Shaqiri sidelined; the midfield pairing of L. Leroy and Metinho will carry heavy load in tight spaces

- **Head-to-head is razor-thin** (1-1-1 in the last three), so expect a tight contest despite the recent form divergence

Expected lineups:

- **Basel**: M. Hitz, D. Schmid, N. Vouilloz, F. Daniliuc, K. Rüegg, L. Leroy, Metinho, B. Traore, A. Bačanin, J. Duranville, I. Salah

- **FC Sion**: A. Racioppi, N. Hefti, K. Hajrizi, J. Kronig, N. Lavanchy, A. Kabacalman, L. Diack, Y. Chouaref, Baltazar, L. S. Chipperfield, R. Nivokazi

Prediction:

**Sion 2-1 Basel**. The form edge and clinical edge in the final third gives them the lean here. 💪

**Córdoba's on a tear, but Sporting just knocked out a rival** — this Segunda División clash looks properly competitive, even if the hosts have momentum on their side. 🔴

Córdoba are riding **3 wins in 5**, including impressive away scalps at Cultural Leonesa and Cádiz. Sporting Gijón have stumbled lately (2W 2L in their last five), though they did put three past Cádiz at home not long ago. The H2H leans Sporting's way historically, but form favors the Cordobans right now.

Key storylines:

- **Córdoba's attacking fluidity** has been the difference — they've scored in every recent outing with **Jacobo González** and **C. Carracedo** creating chances upfront
- **Sporting's defensive solidity** will be tested; they've been leaky on the road, particularly after that Burgos loss
- **J. Salas's absence** (ACL knee injury) means **Córdoba** lose defensive depth, which could leave them exposed on transitions

Expected lineups:

- **Córdoba**: I. Álvarez, Á. Martín, Rubén, C. Albarran, X. Sintes, I. Ruiz, M. Goti, D. Requena, C. Carracedo, A. Fuentes, Jacobo González
- **Sporting Gijón**: R. Yanez, P. Vázquez, G. Rosas, D. Sánchez, B. Olivan, A. Corredera, J. Dubasin, C. Gelabert, J. Otero, D. Queipo, A. Ferrari

Prediction:

**Córdoba 2–1 Sporting Gijón** — home form and current rhythm give the hosts a slight edge in what looks like a proper coin flip. 🎲

**Rayo's the pick here** — they're running hot at home while Real Sociedad can't seem to find stability on the road. 🔴

Rayo have won their last two at Vallecas and sit in decent form, though they'll be without some key defenders. Real Sociedad are leaking goals everywhere (3-3 draws, 2-2 stalemates) and lost their last outing to Getafe. This feels like a chance for Rayo to capitalize.

Key storylines:

- **Rayo's home fortress** has been their strength lately — two straight wins in front of their own fans should carry momentum into this one
- **Real Sociedad's away struggles** continue; they haven't found consistency and will be missing defenders with D. Caleta-Car suspended
- **Firepower matchup** sees **Alemão** and **S. Camello** taking on **Á. Remiro** and a patchy Sociedad backline

Expected lineups:

- **Rayo Vallecano**: D. Cárdenas, A. Rațiu, F. Lejeune, N. Mendy, Pacha, I. Palazón, Ó. Valentín, J. de Frutos, G. Gumbau, Alemão, S. Camello
- **Real Sociedad**: Á. Remiro, S. Gómez, J. Aramburu, J. Martin, A. Muñoz, C. Soler, A. Barrenetxea, M. Oyarzabal, B. Turrientes, O. S. Óskarsson, G. Guedes

Prediction:

**Rayo Vallecano 2-1 Real Sociedad** — the home edge should tell here. Lean Rayo. ⚪

**Stockholm's biggest rivalry is back** — and Hammarby come in hot after demolishing Örgryte 8-1. Djurgården have stumbled lately, losing to Malmö at home, so this is a statement moment. ⚽

Both sides are mixing wins with the occasional clanger. Djurgården sit 3W-2L in their last five but haven't found consistency. Hammarby, meanwhile, are on a proper run: 3W-1D-1L with that monster scoreline proof they can click offensively.

Key storylines:

- **Hammarby's attacking form** has been clinical recently, while **Djurgården's defense** (M. Danielson, M. Tenho) has been breached more often than they'd like
- Head-to-head tells the story: **Hammarby dominate** this fixture with 4 wins in the last six meetings vs just 2 draws for Djurgården
- **N. Žugelj and O. J. Hagen** are the creative sparks each side will lean on in what should be an open, end-to-end affair

Expected lineups:

- **Djurgårdens IF:** J. Rinne, M. Tenho, M. Danielson, J. U. Larsson, A. Stahl, M. Siltanen, M. Anderson, O. Fallenius, P. Åslund, N. Žugelj, S. Haarala
- **Hammarby IF:** W. Hahn, V. Eriksson, F. Winther, H. Skoglund, I. Fofana, N. Besara, M. Karlsson, P. Abraham, M. Madjed, N. Vasic, O. J. Hagen

Prediction:

**Hammarby 2-1 Djurgården.** The edge goes to the visitors — better form, momentum, and the historical head-to-head lean. 🔥

**Two struggling sides collide at the Asito, but one's collapse looks messier than the other.** Both teams are in freefall — Heracles winless in five, Volendam in four consecutive defeats — making this feel like a "who wants it less" affair. 🔴

Heracles have shipped 7 goals in their last two outings (losses to Ajax and Heerenveen), while Volendam at least showed some grit with a 0-0 draw against Feyenoord. The visitors' recent resilience gives them a slight edge, even if both squads are bleeding confidence.

Key storylines:

- **Heracles' injury crisis** — missing F. d. Keijzer, J. Reine-Adélaïde, and J. Žambůrek piles on the misery
- **Volendam's defensive solidity** — that Feyenoord shutout is the only bright spot in a dire run
- **H2H pattern** — the pair drew twice in their last three meetings; another stalemate lurks


Expected lineups:

- **Heracles Almelo**: R. Pasveer, D. v. d. Kust, D. Mirani, I. Mesík, M. Benita, A. V. Hoorenbeeck, S. Scheperman, N. Ünüvar, R. Bozinovski, L. Kulenović, L. Zeefuik
- **FC Volendam**: K. v. Oevelen, Y. Leliendal, M. Amevor, N. Verschuren, P. Ugwu, O. Kökçü, J. Bacuna, J. Ideho, R. v. Cruijsen, B. Kuwas, A. Descotte

Prediction:

**1-1 draw** leans toward a point apiece — both defenses have shown just enough resilience to frustrate, even if the final third is a wasteland. ⚽

**Widzew's home fortress vs Motor's road woes** — this is shaping up as a clash between a team that thrives in front of their own fans and visitors struggling away from Lublin. 🔴

Widzew are drawing too much (3D in last 5) but picked up a crucial W at home against Bruk-Bet. Motor have shown bite with 2W in their last stretch, though they've been sloppy defensively — that 2-3 loss to Katowice stings. The **head-to-head leans Motor's way** (2W vs 1W), but this is a different vibe on Łódź soil.

Key storylines:

- **Widzew's inconsistency at home** needs to flip to three points; they've drawn half their recent matches and can't afford another stalemate
- **Motor's away-day blues** — Lublin's crew haven't looked sharp in hostile territory, and Stadion Widzewa is no picnic
- **S. Bergier and A. Zeqiri for Widzew** vs **K. Czubak and F. Ronaldo for Motor** — the attacking focal points will decide this

Expected lineups:

- **Widzew Łódź**: B. Dragowski, C. Cheng, M. Krajewski, S. Kozlovský, M. Żyro, J. Shehu, E. Kornvig, F. Álvarez, S. Bergier, A. Zeqiri, A. Klukowski

Prediction:

**Widzew 2-1 Motor.** Home edge and Motor's travel troubles give the hosts a slight favorite lean. ⚪

**Genoa's rolling hot, Como's dropping anchors** — the Rossoblu are on a three-win surge while the Lariani are spiraling with just one win in five. This could get messy. 🔴

Genoa's **3-4-2-1 setup** is clicking, especially after back-to-back home victories over Pisa and Sassuolo. Como's defensive woes (conceding 3 and 4 in recent losses) make them vulnerable to Genoa's pace and creativity. The visitors are seriously undermanned too.

Key storylines:

- **Vitinha and Baldanzi** need to keep orchestrating Genoa's attacking rhythm from midfield against a Como side bleeding goals
- **Como's injury crisis** — missing Addai and Vojvoda severely weakens their already fragile backline
- **Home fortress vibes** — Genoa's recent form at Luigi Ferraris is the story; Como haven't won on the road in this stretch

Expected lineups:

- **Genoa**: J. Bijlow, L. Østigård, J. Vásquez, A. Marcandalli, A. Martín, M. Frendrup, M. Ellertsson, Amorim, L. Colombo, Vitinha, T. Baldanzi
- **Como**: J. Butez, M. Kempf, J. Ramón, Á. Valle, D. Carlos, N. Paz, L. Da Cunha, A. Douvikas, M. Perrone, A. Diao, N. Kühn

Prediction:

**Genoa 2-0 Como**. Home momentum and Como's defensive gaps give the Rossoblu a clear edge here. 🎯

**Two teams stuck in neutral collide on Sunday** — Kifisia drawing everything, Panetolikos oscillating between wins and losses. This could get cagey real quick. ⚽

Kifisia's last three are all draws, which tracks with their 0-3-2 record. Panetolikos, meanwhile, has won once in five but lost twice, including a shocker at home vs MGS Panserraikos. The H2H leans hard toward Panetolikos (3 wins in the last five meetings), but Kifisia have the edge in current steadiness.

Key storylines:

- **M. Ramírez** and the Kifisia defense will need to tighten up; three straight 0-0s or draws show they're grinding defensive results but lacking spark
- **Y. Badji** leading Panetolikos' attack on the road, where they notched a 2-1 win over AEL Novibet — away form gives them confidence
- Midfield battle between **L. Amani** and **Pombo** for Kifisia vs the Panetolikos three of **A. Bouchalakis, F. Rosa, A. Mățan** could decide tempo

- **AE Kifisia**: M. Ramírez, D. Chouchoumis, A. Petkov, H. Sousa, C. Konaté, L. Amani, Pombo, R. Pérez, K. Roukounakis, A. Christopoulos, M. Tavares

Prediction:

**1-1 draw** — Both teams will find the net but neither can break through decisively. Lean Kifisia for the slight edge in form, but expect a stalemate. 🤝

**The Dundee derby's heating up, and United look primed to keep their high-rolling form going.** With three wins in their last five and a recent scalp of Celtic under their belt, Jim Goodwin's side have serious momentum heading into this one. 🔥

Dundee, meanwhile, are struggling—just one win in five, including a shocker against Hearts. That shaky defensive record (conceded four to Rangers) could get exposed by United's sharp attack today.

Key storylines:

- **Dundee United's form** is genuinely scary right now; three wins in five with a win over Celtic screams title-race credentials
- **Dundee's defensive frailty** keeps biting them; they've shipped goals for fun and face a United side clicking in the final third
- **The derby factor** keeps these level on head-to-head (2-2 in the last six), but current trajectory favors the Terrors massively

Expected lineups:

- **Dundee United**: D. Richards, K. Keresztes, I. Iovu, R. Graham, D. Naamo, L. Stephenson, V. Ševelj, E. Agyei, A. Ahmed, M. Watters, W. Ferry
- **Dundee FC**: J. McCracken, I. Samuels, L. Graham, R. Astley, D. Wright, T. Yogane, C. Congreve, E. Hamilton, F. Robertson, Y. Dhanda, S. Murray

Prediction:

**Dundee United 2–0 Dundee FC**

Home edge and current form give United the slight lean here. 📍
